name: Chamomile
description: Chamomile produces small daisy-like flowers used in herbal infusions.
usefulInformation: Dry flower heads for a gentle, floral tea.
healthBenefits: May help some people relax; evidence for sleep benefits is mixed.
medicinalUses: Used traditionally for relaxation; avoid if allergic to related plants.

additionalInformation.growingTips: Grow in well-drained soil and adjust watering and sunlight to local conditions.
additionalInformation.harvesting: Harvest gently, leaving enough growth for the plant to recover.
additionalInformation.gardenNote: A useful addition to a kitchen and pollinator-friendly herb garden.
